newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London were mixed to slightly lower in quiet trade ahead of the Christmas holiday break, dealers said.
"It has been a waste of time coming in today. Nobody is about," one trader said.
"Today was Hong Kong's last full day ahead of Christmas. We won't be doing much business here until after New Year."

The Hong Kong Stock Exchange will hold only a morning trading session on Tuesday and is closed on Wednesday and Thursday, December 25 and 26. Normal trade in Hong Kong will resume on Friday, December 27.

In Hong Kong on Monday, the Hang Seng index closed 200.07 points higher at 13,331.48, with buying interest fuelled by Wall Street's recent strength as well as an improved outlook for the local real estate market, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was down 2.74 points at 13,328.74 by 1230 GMT.
